setting.hud.arrayPalette.hint: 保留原版白色，或使用横向彩虹、蓝粉白粉蓝五等分配色；可以叠加原有灰度扫光。
Keep original white, or use a spatial rainbow or five equal blue/pink/white/pink/blue bands. The existing grayscale sweep can be overlaid.
setting.hud.arrayColorAnimation.hint: 关闭后保留静态渐变；不影响功能列表原来的出入场动画。
Disable for a static gradient; the list's existing entrance and exit animations are preserved.
setting.hud.arrayColorPeriod.hint: 一次完整循环的时长，越大越慢。
Duration of one complete cycle. Higher values move more slowly.
setting.hud.arrayColorStrength.hint: 100% 在循环起止处放慢、中段加速；0% 为匀速，两端颜色连续。
At 100%, colors slow near the cycle seam and accelerate through the middle. At 0%, motion is uniform. Colors remain seamless.
setting.hud.arrayColorPhase.hint: 移动整个配色分布；静态模式也可以调节。
Shift the entire palette. Also available when animation is disabled.
setting.watermark.palette.hint: 原来的 RGB 自定义颜色保留；彩虹和跨性别渐变同样支持平面与 3D 水印。
The existing custom RGB color is preserved. Rainbow and transgender gradients support both flat and 3D text.
setting.watermark.colorAnimation.hint: 关闭后保留静态渐变，字体与通用设置同步。
Disable for a static gradient. Text continues using the font selected in General.
setting.watermark.colorPeriod.hint: 一次完整循环的时长，越大越慢。
Duration of one complete cycle. Higher values move more slowly.
setting.watermark.colorStrength.hint: 100% 在循环起止处放慢、中段加速；0% 为匀速。
At 100%, colors slow near the cycle seam and accelerate through the middle. At 0%, motion is uniform.
setting.watermark.colorPhase.hint: 移动整个配色分布；静态模式也可以调节。
Shift the entire palette. Also available when animation is disabled.
